title: P6 Activity Release 26 earned value, estimate and remaining typed semantic evidence tranche
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_rule: This artifact certifies documented read-side API type, unit, and published semantic description only. Writable/default/nullability/import-export certification remains open; conditional computed behavior is preserved as documented rather than generalized.

fields.description: The total cost at completion for the activity, including labor resources, nonlabor resources, and project expenses. At completion total cost = at completion labor cost + at completion nonlabor cost + at completion expense cost.
The sum of the actual plus remaining units for the resource assignment on the activity.

The portion of the project baseline labor units actually completed as of the project data date. Computed as project baseline labor units * performance percent complete; the performance technique depends on the activity WBS earned-value technique.
Estimated labor units at completion. Calculated as actual labor units + estimate to complete labor units; ETC labor units are calculated from the WBS earned-value setting.
Estimated cost to complete the activity. Computed either as remaining total cost or as PF * (BAC - earned value), depending on the WBS earned-value technique.
Estimated quantity to complete. Computed either as remaining total units or PF * (baseline labor units - earned value), depending on the WBS earned-value technique.
Remaining costs for all project expenses associated with the activity.
Remaining costs for all labor resources assigned to the activity. If no resources are assigned, computed as remaining labor units * project default price / time.
Remaining units for all labor resources assigned to the activity. Before start, remaining units equal planned units; after completion, remaining units are zero.
Sum of all material resource remaining costs.
Remaining costs for all nonlabor resources assigned to the activity. If no resources are assigned, computed as remaining nonlabor units * project default price / time.
Remaining units for all nonlabor resources assigned to the activity. Before start, remaining units equal planned units; after completion, remaining units are zero.
Remaining total cost including labor, nonlabor, and project expenses. Remaining total cost = remaining labor costs + remaining nonlabor costs + remaining expense costs.
The sum of remaining labor units and remaining nonlabor units.
The total stored period earned value cost for each activity.
The total stored period earned value labor units for each activity.
The total stored period planned value cost for each activity.
The total stored period planned value labor units for each activity.
